name: r033_phase4_autonomous_sound_return_v1
description: Disposable R-033 semantic-only footing for an autonomous structural sound return. It retains the idle five-member camp and its one non-signal road opportunity, places the passive avatar one OMT south of the route, and adds one active acoustic signal charge at the second route OMT that the native scheduler evaluates during the emission turn, within the initial loaded map. The charge is a real timed native explosion with power four: it emits a significant sound through the production explosion path but has no meaningful blast radius or shrapnel, avoiding the lethal C-4 and the grenade-boundary stall. Authoritative native HUD conversion records saved turn 5306460 as minute 9241. The timer becomes due at minute 9365: 5306460 + (9365 - 9241) * 60 = 5313900. This is after the pair has reached and cohesively assembled at its first local watch (minute 9360); the native turn advances its route to the evaluated second OMT before consuming the due source. Avatar relocation and item staging are zero-credit physical source footing only: they provide no field, sound event, observation, signal lead, report, operation, route, member-state, or owner transition. The native scheduler must first dispatch and move the pair; only a later native countdown event may supply the sound fact and eventual returned_report lead.
